blocks.text: ASTM A295 | Standard Specification for High-Carbon Anti-Friction Bearing Steel

ASTM A295 Scope: This specification covers high-carbon bearing-quality steel to be used in the manufacture of anti-friction bearings. Supplementary requirements of an optional nature are provided and when desired shall be so stated in the order. The values stated in either SI units or inch-pound units are to be regarded separately as standard. The values stated in each system are not necessarily exact equivalents; therefore, to ensure conformance with the standard, each system shall be used independently of the other, and values from the two systems shall not be combined.
